data.one_liner: Define Cloud Functions for Firebase in Dart with support for the Admin SDK and Firestore.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to write and deploy serverless Cloud Functions for Firebase using Dart. It integrates with the Firebase Admin SDK, Cloud Storage, and Firestore, handling requests and responses via Shelf.
use_when: You want to write your Firebase Cloud Functions in Dart instead of Node.js or Python
You need to handle HTTPS triggers and HTTPS-based cloud endpoints in Dart
avoid_when: You need production support for background triggers other than HTTPS triggers
You are not using Firebase for your backend infrastructure
strengths: Enables full-stack Dart development including server-side cloud functions
Integrates with the Firebase Admin SDK and Cloud Storage/Firestore
weaknesses: Background triggers outside of HTTPS are currently experimental
Requires specific Firebase CLI and SDK constraints for native build hooks
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Firebase functions and matching SDK constraints, with specific firebase-tools requirements for deployment.
